{{Top|leg}}
The '''Foundry of the Confederacy''', also known as the '''Cradle of the Confederacy''', was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] around the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] in the distant [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], beyond [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]]. It included the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] and stretched down to the borders of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was so named for the large number of industrial worlds in the region that were under the control of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Felucia_theater.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Felucia theater|attacked]] the Foundry of the Confederacy during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]]]
The region housed some of the most productive [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] industrial [[Planet/Legends|planets]], as well as the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] of some of the Confederacy's most prominent founders, including [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]], [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] and [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]]. During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] in the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the region was known as the [[Felucia theater]] to [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]], and was the scene of some of the fiercest fighting in the conflict as the Republic tried to overcome the Separatists' industrial base.<ref name="TEGtW111">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Following the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|deactivation]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]], the Clone Wars and the Outer Rim Sieges came to an end. The Foundry of the Confederacy, however, was the site of continued resistance by one of the last [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. The [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] leader [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] managed to reactivate several [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|armies]], [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] and [[Factory world/Legends|factory worlds]] in the region. The [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]] was put down in several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of operations by the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], culminating in Toora's [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle of Trasemene|battle]] of [[Trasemene]]. The Foundry of the Confederacy thereafter ceased to exist.<ref name="TEGtW111" />
